comment: lsp4j reads a JSON-RPC error with Gson's reflective adapter. With ResponseError unregistered, native-image reports it as having no fields,
Gson builds an empty one (`"error": {}`), and every error the BSP server returns reaches the user as `ResponseErrorException: null`.
`bleep selftest` parses a JSON-RPC error with lsp4j so CI fails if this goes missing -- see Main.selftestJsonRpcErrors.
